tooltip.createnetherite.netherite_fluid_: Stores %sx as much fluid as a regular Fluid Tank.
gui.booster.netherite_filter.key_hint: Hover an item and press 1-4 to assign its mode
gui.booster.netherite_fan.fallback: Unmatched items use the selected mode
message.createnetherite.netherite_blaze_: This burner already holds four Blazes.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_power: Connect rotational power to the shaft at the back of the fan.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_no_med: Right-click the fan to choose a processing mode. No water, lava or fire block is needed in front of it.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_washin: Washing: coloured wool becomes white wool.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_blasti: Blasting: raw iron becomes an iron ingot.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_filter: Configure original Create filters by holding them and right-clicking.
The fan has one filter slot each for Washing, Blasting, Haunting and Smoking.
Each slot holds one real original filter. Remove it to edit its list.
Right-click the fan and install each configured filter below its matching mode.
Listed items follow their filter rules, even in the same air current.
Unlisted items use the fan's selected mode. This beef is smoked.
The mode buttons change unmatched-item processing; installed filters keep their assigned modes.
Unlisted blue wool now uses Washing; the listed raw iron is still blasted.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_transp: Place items on a depot or belt in the air current, or drop them into the airflow.
createnetherite.ponder.netherite_fan_fil: Filter rules and the selected mode
block.createnetherite.powerful_mechanica: Pumps fluids through connected pipes with _increased throughput_. Supply rotational power to move fluids between tanks and machines.
block.createnetherite.netherite_fluid_ta: Stores fluids in a _multiblock tank_. Supply water and heat, then attach _Netherite Steam Engines_ to use it as a boiler.
block.createnetherite.netherite_steam_en: Converts boiler steam into _rotational power_. Attach to a Netherite Fluid Tank boiler. Each engine supports up to _256 times_ the output of a regular Steam Engine.
block.createnetherite.netherite_item_vau: Stores items in a _multiblock vault_ with _16 times_ the slots of a regular Item Vault.
block.createnetherite.netherite_elevator: Moves elevator contraptions _vertically_. Travels at _twice_ the regular Elevator Pulley speed at the same RPM.
block.createnetherite.netherite_mechanic: Presses items on depots, belts or in a basin. _Batch processing_ repeats matching basin recipes in one working cycle, with the same stress cost as a regular Mechanical Press.
block.createnetherite.netherite_blaze_bu: Holds up to _four Blazes_ to heat machines and boilers. Each Blaze supplies _1 times_ the normal boiler heat and consumes _0.5 times_ the fuel.
Captures _one Blaze_ per right-click until all four places are filled. An empty burner supplies no heat and consumes no fuel.
block.createnetherite.netherite_mechanic: Transfers items between selected input and output points. Movement speed, movement speed cap and working radius are _3 times_ those of a regular Mechanical Arm; stress cost is _1.5 times_ as high.
Mixes recipes in a basin. _Batch processing_ repeats the matching recipe in one mixing cycle. Movement, heating requirements and stress cost follow the regular Mechanical Mixer.
item.createnetherite.netherite_sheet.too: An _upgrade material_ used to craft Netherite variants of Create machines.
block.createnetherite.netherite_wireless: Activate through a Netherite Wireless Manager or its portable version _across dimensions, at any distance_, without frequencies. Outputs a _strength-15_ redstone signal for _1 second_ and keeps its chunk loaded for _15 seconds_. Right-click to edit its name and visibility.
item.createnetherite.netherite_infinite_: Right-click to list _your terminals_ and _public terminals_ placed by other players. _Select across pages_ to activate several at once. Sending renews the 1-second signal and 15-second chunk-loading lease, without frequencies or distance limits.
wireless.createnetherite.owner_only: Only the player who placed this terminal can edit it.
gui.createnetherite.wireless.name: Terminal name
gui.createnetherite.wireless.empty: No terminals available. Place a terminal first.
block.createnetherite.netherite_smart_ch: Moves filtered items _up or down_ without a fan. The native filter and extraction count remain available. Right-click to assign two direction samples and choose the unmatched direction. Redstone _pauses transport_; sneak-right-click empty-handed to retrieve buffered items.
gui.booster.netherite_fan.legacy_returne: Your old Netherite Filter was returned. Install original Create filters in the four slots.
item.createnetherite.netherite_filter.to: Retained for _old saves_. New fans use _four original Create filters_. Old installed Netherite Filters are returned when opening the fan; their saved rules remain available to view.
block.createnetherite.netherite_weighted: Provides _2 times_ the range and _8 times_ the winding progress. Choose _any diagonal or elevated target_ by sneak-right-clicking while holding it, then place it. Right-click an existing platform with a selected-target item to retarget it. Native inventory, stack settings, redstone pause and stress usage remain.
ejector.createnetherite.selected: Target selected: %s, %s, %s. Place or right-click an existing platform to apply.
ejector.createnetherite.cleared: Target cleared. Placement will use the default direction.
ejector.createnetherite.invalid: Invalid target: select another target in this dimension within %s blocks horizontally and vertically.
ejector.createnetherite.busy: Wait for flying items to arrive before changing the target
item.createnetherite.netherite_extendo_g: Adds _3 more blocks_ of block reach than the original. Hold it in the offhand to fill a main-hand empty bucket from a tank. In the main hand, hold right-click to drive a working block; sneak when starting to reverse, release to stop. Drives only the selected block, with capacity for one Powerful Mechanical Pump. Successful bucket fills and sustained power use backtank air, then durability.
grip.createnetherite.cannot_power: Cannot drive: this block already has power, generates power, or needs more than %s SU.
block.createnetherite.netherite_deployer: _Batch-processes_ the current stack on a belt or depot in one action. Materials, tool durability and returned containers are accounted for _per processed item_. Stops when supplies or tools run out and preserves unprocessed inputs. Advances each sequenced-assembly input by one step; native movement speed and stress consumption remain unchanged.
advancement.createnetherite.are_your_tee: Chew Netherite Netherite continuously for more than 10 seconds.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_se: Hold a Netherite Weighted Ejector, then sneak and right-click the target block.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_di: The target may be diagonal, above or below the ejector. Check the previewed path.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_pl: Place the ejector normally after selecting a target. The platform stays flat.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_po: Connect rotational power to the shaft so the ejector can charge.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_in: Put items on the charged platform to launch them automatically.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_ar: A targeted depot receives the items. Keep the flight path clear of solid blocks.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_re: To change the route, select a new target with sneak-right-click while holding an ejector.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_ap: Wait for flying items to arrive, then right-click the existing ejector with the selected target. The held ejector is not consumed.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_qu: Use the side value panel to set the required stack size. Here it is set to four.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_wa: Two items are not enough, so the platform waits.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_fu: Adding two more reaches four and triggers one launch.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_pa: A redstone signal pauses launching, even when the required number of items is present.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.ejector_re: Turn the redstone signal off to resume launching.
createnetherite.ponder.netherite_ejector: Selecting a target and launching items
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_offha: In Survival, put the Netherite Extendo Grip in your offhand.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_bucke: Hold an empty bucket in your main hand and right-click a fluid tank.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_fille: One bucket of fluid leaves the tank and fills your bucket.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_repea: The tank needs at least one bucket of the fluid. Use another empty bucket to collect more.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_resou: Successful bucket fills and sustained hand power use resources. Equipped backtank air is used first, then grip durability when no air is available.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_mainh: To power a working block, move the Netherite Extendo Grip to your main hand.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_limit: Choose an idle working block without external power and within the grip's capacity. One Powerful Mechanical Pump can run this way.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_hold: Keep aiming at the working block and hold right-click. This pump transfers water between the tanks.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_singl: Hand power applies only to the clicked block. Connected shafts and gears do not power other machines.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.grip_stop: Release right-click, look away or switch items to stop supplying power.
createnetherite.ponder.netherite_grip_bu: Filling buckets with an offhand grip
createnetherite.ponder.netherite_grip_po: Powering a working block by hand
block.createnetherite.netherite_converte: Place _two blocks above_ a belt or depot to upgrade items below. Requires a fixed _2048 SU_ and _5 uninterrupted seconds_; speed cannot accelerate it and power loss resets progress. Each conversion uses _250 mB Nether Essence_. Depositing a sheet immediately adds _16 Netherite Value_; a vanilla Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template adds _1_. Ordinary upgrades cost _1 value_; upgrading a Netherite Wrench to a Netherite Netherite Wrench costs _16_. _Right-click with an empty hand_ to view value; picking up the machine preserves it.
item.createnetherite.nether_essence_buck: Mix _Blaze Powder, Nether Wart and Lava_ in a basin using a _Netherite Mechanical Mixer_. Supply it to a Netherite Converter by pipe or bucket; each conversion uses _250 mB_.
converter.createnetherite.status: Netherite Value: %s; Essence: %s/4000 mB; Progress: %s/100; Required: %s SU
block.createnetherite.netherite_wireless: Place and _right-click_ to manage wireless terminals, with _no rotational power_. Lists _your terminals_ and _public terminals_ placed by others. _Select across pages_ to activate several at once. Each player sees only terminals they are allowed to view.
item.createnetherite.netherite_netherite: An _unbreakable Netherite wrench_ with _2 more attack damage_ than a Netherite Sword and the same attack speed. Install up to _8_ module blocks at an _Assembly Table_. Hold _X_ in the main hand and click a wheel region to toggle it; release to close. Starts with _1 active slot_, upgradable to _2_ with a template. Activating beyond the limit disables the oldest module; the latest right-click module takes priority. The key can be rebound. Upgrade a Netherite Wrench in a _Converter_ for _16 Netherite Value_; retains _2 extra blocks of main-hand block reach_.
With a pump, press or burner active
Pump adds _6 damage_, _1 attack reach_ and _2 knockback levels_. Press makes total damage _1.5 times_ and roots for _1 second_. Burner multiplies your fire damage by _4_.
With a fan or ejector active

Fan: _hold right-click_ for airflow; press _Shift_ to toggle push/pull. Ejector: _hold Shift+right-click to charge_, then release to launch. Full charge takes _1 second_, up to _64 blocks_. Ordinary right-click and insufficient charge do not launch. Hitting obstacles restores fall damage.
With an engine, converter or tank active

Engine: _hold right click_ to power one work block. Converter: _right click a creature_ to netheritize it and obtain a one-use template on death. Tank: _right click_ collects, _Shift_ selects fluid, _Shift+right click_ places; total _64 buckets_.
block.createnetherite.netherite_mechanic: Cuts an entire stack in _one processing cycle_, preserving native filtering, stonecutting and sequenced assembly. Tree-cutting calculation speed is _2 times_ normal; damage is _1.8 times_, with unchanged stress. Install in the Netherite Netherite Wrench and _hold right-click_ to saw the nearest target ahead within attack reach. Blocks obstruct the blade.
item.createnetherite.netherite_netherite: _Hold right-click_ to saw the nearest target ahead within attack reach. Uses a 256 RPM reference for _18 damage_ per hit, respects native hurt cooldown and is blocked by solid blocks.
wrench.createnetherite.ejector_aim: Hold Shift + right-click; release to launch
block.createnetherite.assembly_table.too: Insert a _Netherite Netherite Wrench_ to install or remove up to _8_ module blocks. Requires no power. Insert one vanilla _Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template_ and click Upgrade to unlock the _second active slot_.
wrench.createnetherite.wheel_hint: Hold %s and click to toggle; release to close
item.createnetherite.netherite_wrench.to: Adds _2 blocks of block interaction reach_ in the main hand, retaining the original Create wrench's _rotation and dismantling_ with no durability. Craft shapelessly from a _Create Wrench + Netherite Sheet_, or upgrade with a _Netherite Converter_. Convert it again for _16 Netherite Value_ to obtain the Netherite Netherite Wrench.
